title: SIDESTORY: UNDER TIDES RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: UNDER TIDES RERUN
EVENT DURATION: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 9, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Under Tides event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
- [Deserted Salviento] Duration: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 5, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Choppy Ruin] Duration: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 5, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[TRY TO SURVIVE]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Try to Survive] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★★: Gladiia, Iberian Resort Town Furniture (Pieces), Corrupted Iberian Records.
[BARTER]
DURATION: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 9, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Corrupted Iberian Records by clearing event stages and Try to Survive missions. Corrupted Iberian Records can be used to redeem items from [Barter].
MAIN REWARDS: Gladiia's Token, Iberian Resort Town Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Records, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Intermezzi].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.
- During the event rerun, the event button in [Intermezzi] will temporarily redirect you to the event rerun page.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Skadi the Corrupting Heart, Gladiia, Kal'tsit, and Akafuyu will gain more trust during the event rerun.
02 BLOODLINE OF COMBAT COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 9, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Return for Gladiia
03 I.T CROSSOVER SERIES RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 9, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
I.T Collab Outfit - Cómodo for Thorns
I.T Collab Outfit - Liberté//Échec for Surtr
I.T Collab Outfit - Ursus IO79 for Zima
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – IBERIAN RESORT TOWN
DURATION: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 9, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Under Tides event rewards and redeem in Barter (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces) from November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) to December 9, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
05 LUMINOUS DAYLIGHT LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: November 28, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7) - December 8, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to earn the following rewards:
Event Furniture, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Orundum, Elite Materials, etc.
Day 1: Yanese Wooden Lamppost * 1, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 2: LMD * 10000, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Pure Gold * 55, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 4: Strategic Battle Record * 10, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 5: LMD * 20000, Orundum * 200
Day 6: Chip Catalyst * 1, Originite Prime * 1
Day 7: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 15
NOTE:
- The Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event will be expired on December 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
- Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
06 RECORD RESTORATION: DARKNIGHTS MEMOIR
UPDATE TIME: November 25, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The Record Restoration of Darknights Memoir will be open after the next update. The limited event rewards will be permanently available for players to unlock.
